layman_headline: Market is hot — too hot to chase, waiting for a dip to buy.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just surged 14% in a week and most altcoins are up 10-30%. The market mood is 'Greed' and rising, which historically means we're closer to a short-term top than a bottom. Every swing candidate on the watchlist is either massively overbought (like PUMP with an RSI of 84), a stablecoin, or has already run 25-60% in a week with no clear pullback entry. Chasing these moves now would mean buying near short-term highs with poor risk/reward.
layman_action: Wait. Do not chase this rally. Set alerts for ETH around $2,380 or SOL around $93 — if we get a healthy 5-7% pullback in the next few days, that's the time to strike.
expert_reasoning: All swing candidates present poor risk/reward at current levels. PUMP has an RSI of 84 with a 63% weekly gain — textbook overbought. MON and LIT have rallied 27-33% with no RSI or MACD data to confirm continuation. The broader market (Fear & Greed at 71, trending toward 'worsening' greed) and high BTC dominance at 59.1% signal that altcoin risk is elevated. Bitcoin dipping below $78K on higher PCE inflation data is a warning sign that this rally may face macro headwinds. The disciplined play is to wait for a retracement — ETH toward the $2,350-2,400 zone would offer a proper swing setup with defined downside risk.
risk_factors: Higher US PCE inflation data could trigger broader risk-off selling, pushing crypto lower than expected pullback levels
BTC dominance at 59.1% means capital is flowing to Bitcoin, not alts — alt positions face additional headwind
Greed sentiment trending higher ('worsening') increases probability of a sharp correction within days
watch_list: ETH price action — watch for pullback to $2,350-2,400 zone as potential swing entry
BTC reaction to $78K support — if it breaks, alts will sell off harder and create better entries
Fear & Greed Index — if it pushes above 75, correction risk increases significantly
market_context: Crypto is in a strong short-term rally with BTC up 14% in a week, but macro headwinds from rising PCE inflation and a Fear & Greed index at 71 trending greedier suggest this move is getting extended. High BTC dominance at 59.1% means altcoin upside is capped relative to Bitcoin.
context_banner: Strong rally across the board but all setups are extended — discipline says wait for a pullback rather than chase parabolic moves.

key_signals.description: PUMP's RSI at 84 is deeply overbought — the only candidate with RSI data confirms the broader theme that this rally is extended.
Fear & Greed at 71 and trending higher ('worsening') indicates the market is approaching euphoria levels where corrections become likely.
Bitcoin dipping below $78K on higher US PCE inflation data signals macro headwinds that could trigger a broader pullback — creating the entry opportunity we're waiting for.
Ethereum quantum-resistant staking proposal and SEC crypto custody rule activity provide fundamental catalysts that make ETH attractive on a pullback.
Ethereum's $49.3B TVL dominance confirms strong fundamental support and makes it the highest-conviction pullback buy candidate.
